characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series, What If...? (2021-2023), and Marvel Comics tie-ins
characters.summary: Strange Supreme is a corrupted, vastly more powerful alternate-timeline variant of Doctor Strange who absorbed countless mystical entities and extradimensional creatures—including demons and abstract monsters—to gain god-like magical supremacy. He fights with overwhelming, reality-shattering dark sorcery, energy manipulation, demon summoning, and structural temporal absorption.

techniques: Absorbing mystical creatures and entities into his own body to increase power
Summoning extradimensional demons and tentacled monsters
Conjuring reality-tearing energy blasts and destructive spatial distortions
Manipulating timelines and shielding entire realities within magical barriers
Alternate Strange who absorbed countless mystical beings and his own other half
Vast dark-magic power; fought Ultron with the Guardians of the Multiverse

mechanisms: Impenetrable mystical energy shields and multidimensional barriers
Regenerative durability augmented by absorbed supernatural entities
Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Internal psychological instability and deep grief-driven obsession over Christine Palmer
Vulnerability to catastrophic paradoxes when tampering with absolute time points
His obsession destroyed his own universe

depictions.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

limitations: Cannot alter absolute fixed temporal points without destroying reality
Prone to emotional manipulation regarding the loss of Christine Palmer
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard peaceful sorcery with aggressive dark magic fueled by the bodily and energetic absorption of thousands of magical beings, resulting in vastly higher raw power, monstrous physical transformations when channeling absorbed entities, and corrupted morality.

Absorbed his timeline's standard counterpart to complete his power accumulation.
